picker.speciesIntro: The species decides the care: a dog goes for walks, a cat plays at home and uses a litter box.

speciesHints.dog: Meals, water, walks with real steps, cleaning up.
speciesHints.cat: Meals, water, play with a feather wand, litter box.

picker.title: Choose a dog for {{name}}
picker.intro: Your choice shapes what caring for the dog will be like — just like with a real dog.

free.title: Free mixed breed
free.hint: Free forever. All the care and game rules, without the 12-week programme or a certificate; history of the last 7 days. The dog is always a mixed breed.

challenge.title: 12-week challenge — {{price}}
challenge.hint: The programme that shows whether your child is ready for a dog, with a paid breed of your choice, a certificate and the full history. The challenge starts with a purchase: the dog waits until you buy it for this dog (also possible before the contract is signed). One-time payment, no subscription. Want to try first? Choose the free mixed breed.

freeTrial.title: The free mutt is a limited trial
freeTrial.intro: It shows the basics of caring for a dog. Compared with the breeds of the 12-week challenge, it has no:

items.history: full history — you see the last 7 days,
items.origin: choice of origin or coat colour — the dog is always adopted from a shelter,
items.media: full video set — only idle and sleeping, no hungry, tired, sick, play, school or transition clips,
items.care: brushing or the special care many breeds need (teeth, ears, skin folds, nails).

freeTrial.cta: For the full experience, choose a breed in the 12-week challenge.

picker.breedFreeNote: On the free plan the dog is always a mixed breed. Paid breeds are part of the 12-week challenge.
picker.breedChallengeNote: The 12-week challenge is with a paid breed. The mixed breed is the free plan's dog — choose “Free mixed breed” for it.
picker.originAdoptionOnly: {{breed}} isn’t a pedigree breed. Breeders only raise pedigree animals, so adoption is the only option.
